scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic proof with finite rational cross-checks. No field-data inference, no causal interpretation, and no claim of independent scientific validation or exhaustive bibliographic uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Uniform fixed-size sampling without replacement; pairwise dissimilarities fixed; sharp universal bound concerns populations of at most four individuals, and the exact formula concerns one doubleton with otherwise singleton species at a sample omitting one individual. Arbitrary fixed ultrametric trees are not classified.
title: A sharp five-individual reversal of richness–Rao covariance under ultrametric rarefaction
